criteria.given: A broad typed model or malformed graph/reference/lifecycle
then: Valid models are accepted and duplicate/broken identities, illegal edges/cardinality/cycles, malformed fields and lifecycle conflicts produce precise nonmutating diagnostics

criteria.given: A valid Engineering Model with decisions and dependent tasks
criteria.when: A digest-bound semantic edit or concurrent stale edit is submitted
then: Through a pre/post-validated action, attributable history, revisions, blockers and transitive decision invalidation persist; invalid/stale changes cannot publish or overwrite the last stable state

criteria.given: Canonical scenario/test references and coordinator evidence, possibly missing, tampered or historical
criteria.when: Read-only scenario and evidence projection runs
then: Assertions, actual outcomes and revision provenance are inspected through existing authority; missing/invalid/historical evidence is honest and inspection writes nothing

criteria.given: One revisioned model used by agents and humans
criteria.when: Public CLI validates, projects JSON/Markdown and performs a decision journey
then: Both projections retain identical IDs/digest and task/attention state, useful errors preserve data and CLI edits survive reload

criteria.given: A validated workstream snapshot and canonical evidence references
then: UI displays canonical assertions/tests/revisions and honest evidence states, consuming the shared validated snapshot without duplicating domain-validation or repair rules

criteria.given: An attention item, valid/invalid decision form or concurrently changed definition
criteria.when: The developer records a reasoned choice then reloads, or submits a stale/invalid form
then: A valid choice persists and changes task attention; stale or invalid submissions reject without writes

criteria.given: Current and candidate document states, referenced specifications, external saves and concurrent changes
criteria.when: Any state-changing engineering action or specification change is admitted and published
then: Validate the current stable state before invoking the action and the complete resulting state afterward; failures or stale identities prevent publication
Every spec change invalidates affected validation, including linked-spec-only edits; startup/action/read checks recover from missed external-save events
Readers consume one validated generation, with content/dependency/rule-bound identity; incremental/cache behavior agrees with full validation and no broken or mixed state is actionable
